title: Nourishing Smoky Malaysian Morcilla Satay
description: A Malaysian dish featuring morcilla, smoky and earthy flavors, perfect for midnight cravings. It combines the richness of morcilla with the freshness of raw ingredients.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Slice the morcilla into 1-inch pieces and set aside.
In a blender, combine coconut milk, lemongrass, galangal, lime juice, salt, and black pepper, and blend until smooth.
Thread the morcilla pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the peanut oil onto the morcilla pieces.
Grill the satay for 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Serve the satay hot with the coconut milk sauce for dipping.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve immediately.
